title: Area Summary Columnar Transport v1
description: A derived, download-sized copy of one governed area-summary product (area-summary.v2 or a legacy generation), generated by scripts/build_area_summary_columns.py and never edited by hand. The governed product stays canonical: decoding this file, as {...header, rows}, reproduces that product exactly, and the CI round-trip check enforces it. Every row of the product carries the same keys in the same order; keys lists them. A key whose value is identical on every row is stored once in constants; a key with few distinct values is stored in encoded as the distinct values plus one integer position per row; every other key is stored in columns as one value per row. The three groups partition keys. The map runtime reads this file only where a level's REGION_CONFIG names summaryColumns, and falls back to the governed product on any error.

source_file.description: File name of the governed product this file was derived from, in the same directory.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the governed product's bytes at generation.

header.description: Every top-level field of the governed product except rows, verbatim.

keys.description: Row keys, in the order each decoded row lists them.

constants.description: Keys whose value is identical on every row.

values.description: Distinct values, in order of first appearance.

index.description: One position into values per row.

columns.description: Keys stored as one value per row.
